blocks.text: In order to provide the Zscaler Asset Exposure Management (AEM) service, Zscaler has the right to process, use, reproduce, store, modify, and display the information from logs. For AEM, logs are defined as the configuration and transaction data collected for actions performed by users authorized by you who are acting within the AEM SaaS Application.

Zscaler retains the logs on a rolling period up to a year during your subscription term. When the subscription term ends or expires, the logs are deleted by Zscaler according to applicable retention cycles.
For the Mapping Copilot feature, prompts and responses are stored by Zscaler for 90 days as part of the session history. Mapping Copilot is not trained using any customer data.
Logs are stored in the United States.
